newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berentzen prices new prefs at 41.25 DM.
newsitem.headline: Berentzen prices new prefs at 41.25 DM.

text.p: German distiller Berentzen-Gruppe AG said on Wednesday it would price an issue of 1.6 million new preferred shares at 41.25 marks to raise 66 million marks mainly for new acquisitions.
The issue of new shares, which will be entitled to a 1996 dividend, will raise Berentzen's capital by 20 percent to a nominal 48 million marks.
Subscriptions are open from September 26 to October 11, Berentzen said in a regulatory news release.
The issue will raise the proportion of Berentzen shares in free float to 50 percent. The company's main shareholders will not exercise subscription rights.

Managing board spokesman Jan Berentzen said two takeovers would be completed within two weeks. The first is the purchase of a foreign spirits maker that will mark the company's first investment abroad. The second purchase will be a mineral water spring.
